capabilities: Show the current task in the status bar
Add tasks via the command palette
Log completed tasks with timestamps to doing.md
Keep a task history in doing.md
problem: Users who switch between contexts often lose track of what task they were working on, and Obsidian has no built-in reminder of the current task.
summary: Task tracker that shows your current task in the status bar and logs completed tasks with timestamps to a doing.md file.
